title_zh: 美丽的数学：奇妙的种子
source_file: 美丽的数学：奇妙的种子 （5-7岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 安野光雅 “美丽的数学” 系列
奇妙的种子
[日]安野光雅 著·绘
艾茗 译
九州出版社
JUZHOUPRESS

[P2] 奇妙的种子
［日］安野光雅 著·绘
艾茗 译

中国城市出版社
·北京·

[P3] 很久很久以前，在某个地方住着一个懒惰的男人。
有一年的冬天，
当这个男人正望着天空发呆的时候，
来了一位仙人。
仙人对他说：“我给你两颗奇妙的种子吧。你把其中一颗烤烤吃掉的话，一整年你都不会觉得肚子饿。另外的一颗把它埋在地里，来年的秋天一定能收获两颗种子的。”
说完就给了他两颗奇妙的种子。

[P4] 这个男人把其中的一颗种子烤熟之后吃下去了。原本金色的种子烤熟之后变成了红色。这颗种子的味道好极了。而且，正如仙人所说的那样，只要吃一颗下去，肚子就变得饱饱的。
男人把另外一颗种子埋在了地里。第二年的春天，长出了可爱的新芽。
秋天到了，正如仙人说的那样，果真收获了两颗种子。
到了夏天，开出了美丽的花朵。
冬天，男人把其中的一颗种子烤熟吃掉之后，把剩下的一颗埋在了土里。

[P5] 春天，
种子发芽了。

秋天到了。
又收获了两颗种子。

夏天，
美丽的花儿开了。

冬天，男人烤熟了其中的一颗种子吃下去，
把另外的一颗埋到了土里。

[P6] 第二年，同样开花，同样收获了两颗种子。
这个男人同样吃掉了烤熟的一颗，把另外一颗埋入土里。
再过一年，一样的开花，一样的长出了两颗种子。
男人吃掉了一颗种子，把另外一颗埋入土里。

[P7] 隔年，一样的开花，一样的结出了两颗种子。
男人一样的吃掉了一颗种子，再把另一颗埋入土里。
再隔一年，一样的开花，一样的长出了两颗种子。
男人一样的吃掉了一颗种子，再把另一颗埋入土里。

[P8] 这个男人终于意识到了问题。他心想：“这样下去的话，不论过多久都是重复同样的生活。不如今年把两颗种子都埋在地里，然后找点别的东西吃，凑合一下吧。”

那一年的冬天，男人果真把珍藏的两颗种子细心地种在了地里。

[P9] 下一年（也就是改变之后的第一年），你猜会有什么不一样的事发生呢？春天发芽，到了秋天收获了四颗种子！男人烤了其中的一颗种子吃了，把剩下的三颗埋入了地里。

再接下来的一年（改变后的第二年），春天发芽，秋天收获了六颗种子。男人吃下了一颗种子，冬天时把剩下的五颗种子埋在了地里。

为了怕麻雀和乌鸦来偷吃，男人做了一个“鸣笛”来吓唬鸟雀。风一吹，鸣笛一响，鸟雀们就被吓飞了。

你猜，第二年的秋天能采摘多少颗种子呢？

[P10] 接下来的一年（也就是改变之后的第三年），春天发芽，秋天收获了十颗种子。冬天男人种下了九颗种子。

第二年（也就是第四年），春天发芽，秋天收获了18颗种子。冬天，男人种下了17颗种子。

接下来的一年（也就是第五年），春天发芽，秋天收获了很多颗种子。冬天男人吃了一颗之后把剩下的种子全都埋在了地里。他一共埋了多少颗种子在地里呢？

[P11] 接下来的一年（第六年），那一年的秋天收获了好多颗种子，多得简直数不清。采摘种子的工作忙得不可开交的时候，一个路过的女人帮了他的忙。那一年一共收获了多少颗种子呢？

男人和女人各烤了一颗种子吃下去。那一年的冬天，他们把剩下的种子都埋在了地里。
一共埋了多少颗呢？

[P12] 接下来的一年（第七年），春天发芽，秋天收获了好多颗种子。
那年冬天，两人高高兴兴地举办了结婚典礼。婚礼上来了五个朋友。
他们给每个朋友分别送了两颗种子。其中一颗是给他们带回家当礼物的。
两个人分别吃了一颗。那一年男人建了个谷仓，储藏了16颗种子。
剩下的种子全部埋在了地里。男人已经没办法再继续懒惰下去了。
他一共种了多少颗种子呢？

[P13] 接下来的一年（第八年），春天长出了好多好多的新芽，秋天收获了好多好多颗种子。
因为这一年的收成实在太好了，所以他们连同原来贮藏在谷仓的种子一起，一共运了60颗到镇上去卖。
扣除两人吃掉的两颗，重新在谷仓里贮藏了34颗种子。剩下的种子统统埋在了地里。地里一共埋了多少颗种子呢？

[P14] 接下来的一年（第九年），
春天长出了好多好多的新芽，秋天结了好多好多的种子。

他们的孩子也出生了。冬天，全家共吃了三颗种子。因为收获
的种子太多了，所以连同原来贮藏在谷仓里的种子一起，一共运了
100颗种子到镇上去卖。另外在谷仓里贮藏了51颗新种子。
然后把剩下的都埋在了地里。到底一共埋了多少颗种子呢？

[P15] 接下来的一年（第十年），秋天到了，地里结满了种子。他们的孩子长大了，房子也盖成了。就在快要收成的时候，好像开始起风了。

[P16] 啊！是暴风雨呢！好天气持续了那么久，
谁也没想到会有台风来袭。河水涨满，变成了
洪水。男人赶紧把房子绑在树上，把牛赶进车
里。车子像船一样浮在水面上。妈妈紧紧地抱
着孩子爬到了顶楼上。他们好不容易才把装满
了珍贵的种子的袋子绑在了树上。

暴风雨真可怕呀！大树在狂风中摇晃，雨滴噼噼啪啪地扑打在人的脸上。浑浊的河
水咆哮着奔涌而去，大地变成了一片汪洋。田里的农作物被冲走了，谷仓也被冲散了。

[P17] 可怕的暴风雨终于停了。天空开始放晴。暴风雨过后的景象真是惨不忍睹。
妈妈说：“咱们家孩子没事真是太好了。”
“真是太好了。而且耕牛也平安无事，十颗种子没有被冲走。那我们打起精神从头再来吧。”爸爸也说道。

[P18] 他们吃掉了三颗种子，然后把剩下的种在了地里。
他们虔诚地向上天祈求：“老天啊，请千万保佑我们今年丰收吧。”
full_text_en:
[P1] Yoshio Anno "Beautiful Mathematics" Series
The Magical Seeds
[Japan] Yoshio Anno, Author & Illustrator
Translated by Ai Ming
Jiu Zhou Press
JUZHOUPRESS

[P2] The Magical Seed
[Japan] Mitsumasa Anno, Author & Illustrator
Ai Ming, Translator

China City Publishing House
·Beijing·

[P3] Long, long ago, in some place, there lived a lazy man.
One winter,
when the man was gazing blankly at the sky,
a fairy appeared.
The fairy said to him: "I'll give you two magical seeds. If you roast and eat one of them, you won't feel hungry all year. If you bury the other one in the ground, you'll surely harvest two seeds next autumn."
And then, the fairy gave him the two magical seeds.

[P4] The man ate one of the seeds after roasting it. The originally golden seed turned red after roasting. The seed tasted wonderful. And, just as the immortal had said, eating just one made his stomach feel full.
He planted the other seed in the ground. In the following spring, a cute sprout grew.
Autumn came, and just as the immortal had said, he truly harvested two seeds.
By summer, beautiful flowers bloomed.
In winter, the man roasted and ate one of the seeds, then planted the remaining one in the soil.

[P5] Spring,
the seed sprouted.

Autumn has come.
He harvested two seeds again.

Summer,
beautiful flowers bloomed.

Winter, the man roasted one of the seeds and ate it,
and buried the other one in the soil.

[P6] The second year, the same flowers bloomed, and the same two seeds were harvested.
This man again ate one roasted seed and buried the other in the soil.
Another year passed, with the same flowers blooming and the same two seeds growing.
The man ate one seed and buried the other in the soil.

[P7] The following year, it bloomed as usual and bore two seeds.
The man ate one seed and buried the other in the soil.
Another year passed, and it bloomed again, producing two seeds.
The man ate one seed and buried the other in the soil.

[P8] The man finally realized the problem. He thought to himself, "If I keep going like this, no matter how long it takes, I'll just be repeating the same life. Maybe this year I should bury both seeds in the ground, and then find something else to eat, just to get by." 

That winter, the man indeed carefully planted the two precious seeds he had kept in the ground.

[P9] The next year (the first year after the change), do you guess what different things will happen? In spring, it sprouted, and by autumn, four seeds were harvested! The man roasted one of the seeds and ate it, then buried the remaining three in the ground.

The following year (the second year after the change), it sprouted in spring and six seeds were harvested in autumn. The man ate one seed and buried the remaining five in the ground during winter.

To prevent sparrows and crows from stealing the seeds, the man made a 'whistle' to scare the birds. When the wind blew and the whistle sounded, the birds were frightened away.

Do you guess how many seeds can be harvested in autumn of the second year?

[P10] The following year (the third year after the change), in spring the seeds sprouted, and in autumn he harvested ten seeds. In winter, the man planted nine seeds.

The next year (the fourth year), in spring the seeds sprouted, and in autumn he harvested 18 seeds. In winter, the man planted 17 seeds.

The following year (the fifth year), in spring the seeds sprouted, and in autumn he harvested many seeds. In winter, the man ate one seed and then buried all the remaining seeds in the ground. How many seeds did he bury in the ground?

[P11] The following year (the sixth year), in autumn, they harvested many, many seeds—so many they couldn’t count them all. When the work of harvesting became overwhelming, a woman passing by helped him. How many seeds did they harvest that year?

The man and the woman each roasted and ate one seed. That winter, they buried the remaining seeds in the ground.
How many seeds did they bury in total?

[P12] The following year (the seventh year), the seeds sprouted in spring and yielded many seeds in autumn.
That winter, the two happily held a wedding ceremony. Five friends came to the wedding.
They gave two seeds to each friend. One of them was for the friends to take home as a gift.
The two of them each ate one seed. That year, the man built a granary and stored 16 seeds.
The remaining seeds were all buried in the ground. The man could no longer afford to be lazy.
How many seeds did he plant in total?

[P13] The following year (the eighth year), spring brought many, many new sprouts, and autumn yielded many, many seeds.
Because the harvest was so good, they took all the seeds originally stored in the granary and together transported 60 seeds to town to sell.
After deducting the two seeds they ate, they stored 34 seeds back in the granary. The remaining seeds were all buried in the ground. How many seeds were buried in the ground?

[P14] The following year (the ninth year),
In spring, many, many new sprouts grew, and in autumn, many, many seeds formed.

Their child was also born. In winter, the whole family ate three seeds. Because the harvest
of seeds was so abundant, they took, together with the seeds originally stored in the granary, a total of
100 seeds to sell in town. Additionally, they stored 51 new seeds in the granary.
Then they buried the rest in the ground. How many seeds were buried in total?

[P15] The following year (the tenth year), autumn arrived, and the fields were full of seeds. Their child had grown up, and the house was built. Just as they were about to harvest, it seemed as if the wind was starting to blow.

[P16] Ah! It's a storm! The good weather had lasted so long,
no one expected a typhoon to come. The river swelled and turned into
floodwaters. The man quickly tied the house to the tree and drove the cow into the
wagon. The wagon floated on the water like a boat. The mother tightly hugged
her child and climbed to the top floor. They finally managed to tie the bag full
of precious seeds to the tree.

The storm was terrible! The big tree swayed in the fierce wind, and raindrops pattered
against people's faces. The muddy river roared and surged away, turning the land into
a vast ocean. The crops in the fields were washed away, and the granary was scattered too.

[P17] The terrible storm finally stopped. The sky began to clear. The scene after the storm was heartbreaking.
Mom said, “It’s such a relief that our child is safe.”
“Indeed it is. And the ox is safe too, and we didn’t lose those ten seeds. Let’s cheer up and start over,” Dad said.

[P18] They ate three seeds and then planted the rest in the ground.
They sincerely prayed to heaven: "Oh, God, please protect us and grant us a bountiful harvest this year."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《奇妙的种子》的封面，展示了作者安野光雅、译者艾茗及出版社信息，画面中一位老人和一个孩子站在幼苗间，老人手持拐杖，孩子手持种子，背景点缀着绿色嫩芽。
[P2] 本页为绘本《奇妙的种子》的扉页，展示了书名、作者安野光雅、译者艾茗及出版社信息，画面中一位老人将两颗种子递给一个孩子，背景简洁，突出人物互动。
[P3] 本页讲述了很久以前，一个懒惰的男人在冬天发呆时，一位仙人出现并赠予他两颗奇妙的种子，告诉他一颗可吃以饱腹，另一颗可埋土中来年收获两颗。
[P4] 本页通过四个分镜展示了男人种植奇妙种子的过程：他吃掉一颗种子后感到饱腹，将另一颗种下，第二年春天长出新芽，秋天收获两颗种子，夏天开花，冬天再次重复种植过程。
[P5] 本页通过四个分镜展示了奇妙种子的生长周期：春天发芽，夏天开花，秋天收获两颗种子，冬天男人吃掉一颗并埋下另一颗，为下一个生长周期做准备。
[P6] 本页通过两个分镜展示了奇妙种子的持续生长循环：第二年和第三年，植物如期开花结果，男人重复吃掉一颗种子并埋下另一颗的种植行为。
[P7] 本页通过两个分镜展示了奇妙种子的持续生长循环：第二年和第三年，植物如期开花结果，男人重复吃掉一颗种子并埋下另一颗的种植行为。
[P8] 男人意识到重复种植种子的生活没有改变，决定将两颗种子都种下，尝试寻找其他食物，画面展示了他冬天种下种子的场景。
[P9] 本页通过两个分镜展示了男人在改变种植方式后的第一年和第二年，种子数量持续增长，他分别收获四颗和六颗种子，并继续埋下剩余种子；同时，为防鸟雀偷吃，他制作了鸣笛，最后以提问形式引导读者思考第二年秋天的收获量。
[P10] 本页通过三个分镜展示了男人改变种植方式后的第三、四、五年，种子数量持续增长，他分别收获十颗、十八颗种子，并继续埋下剩余种子；最后以提问形式引导读者思考第五年冬天他埋下多少颗种子。
[P11] 本页描绘了第六年秋天收获大量种子的场景，男人在采摘时得到一位路过的女人帮助，两人各吃掉一颗种子后，将剩余种子埋入地下，并以提问形式引导读者思考收获与埋种的数量。
[P12] 第七年秋天收获大量种子后，男女主角举办婚礼，招待五位朋友并赠送种子，两人各吃一颗，剩余种子中16颗储藏，其余全部埋入地下，最后以提问形式引导读者计算总种植量。
[P13] 第八年秋天收获大量种子，男女主角将部分种子运到镇上出售，扣除两人食用的两颗后，将34颗种子重新贮藏，其余种子全部埋入地下，并提问读者计算埋入地下的种子数量。
[P14] 第九年，主人公一家迎来了新生儿，收获的种子数量庞大，他们运了100颗去镇上出售，贮藏了51颗，剩余的全部埋入地下，并向读者提问埋种总数。
[P15] 本页描绘了第十个秋天，主人公一家的孩子已长大，新房子也建好了，田地里结满了种子，但就在即将收获时，风开始吹起。
[P16] 第十个秋天，主人公一家遭遇台风和洪水，他们将房子、牛车和装有种子的袋子绑在树上避险，但田里的农作物和谷仓被冲走，家园遭受严重破坏。
[P17] 第十个秋天，台风和洪水过后，一家人幸存下来，孩子、耕牛和十颗种子都安然无恙，父母在废墟中互相安慰，决定重新开始。
[P18] 第十个秋天，一家人将收获的种子吃掉三颗后，把剩下的种入地里，并虔诚地向上天祈求丰收。
[P19] 本页画面展示了一组排列整齐的绿色幼苗，共四行，每行五株，总计二十株，象征着新生命的萌发与希望，呼应前文一家人灾后重新播种、祈求丰收的情节。
